consequence.statement: Purely additive release-note item: operators gain the option of sparse checkout in the flux CLI; the note describes no change to existing configuration, resources, or workloads, so an operator who does nothing sees no operational difference.

assertion.statement: The flux v2.7.0 release notes state that sparse checkout support was added to the flux CLI, without naming the flag, subcommand, or field that implements it.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the note names only 'sparse checkout' and 'cli'; it gives no flag name, subcommand, field path, or value key, so no family identity can be pinned; applicability: the note names no flag, subcommand, values key, resource, or version boundary; the feature is a new CLI capability exercised at command time, so no static environment predicate can identify exposure
